mentions.name: mpz
mentions.description: This music player app currently works as a standalone player and is adding MPD client mode, enabling playback on a separate MPD server/device while keeping the same music player interface. The project's code is at the linked GitHub repository.
mentions.problem: The author wanted the ability to play music on a separate device without giving up the music player UX they like.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on adding MPD [1] client mode to my music player: https://github.com/olegantonyan/mpz

Currently it works as standalone player. Addition of MPD client mode opens possibility to play music on a separate device while keeping the UX of the music player that I like.
